name: Franz Kiel GmbH
summary: Franz Kiel GmbH reported consolidated revenue of approximately €180 million for the 2023 fiscal year, but no profitability, cash‑flow, debt or liquidity data are disclosed. [1] The company employs about 1,500 people worldwide with 250 at its Nördlingen headquarters, indicating operational scale. [1] It holds ISO 14001:2015 certification and publishes annual environmental reports that track energy, water consumption and waste volumes, with reduction targets consistently met. [7] [8] Despite a ~20 % production increase in 2023 versus 2022, significant reductions in environmental impact were still achieved. [8] Products are designed as modular, repairable systems using lightweight materials to lower fuel consumption, and the sustainability policy emphasizes innovative materials, environmentally friendly manufacturing and an internal employee‑suggestion scheme. [9] [10] [11]
